conditions.shared_qwen_alone: Untouched shared Qwen; no personal delta.
conditions.wrong_same_role_pair: Even-indexed questions use CAUSE-I twice; odd-indexed questions use SAFETY-I twice.
conditions.semantic_text_capsules: Untouched shared Qwen receives the same two correct claims as readable text.
conditions.correct_neural_pair: CAUSE-I and SAFETY-I hidden deltas are joined by the trained bridge. No claims are added as text.

automatic_score: A response is provisionally complete only when normalized text contains both frozen expected statements.
